Plant Watering Scheduler

Never forget to water again: per-plant watering intervals, next-due dates computed from the last watering, and one-tap 'watered' check-off.

My plants

PlantEveryLast wateredNext dueStatus

📖 How to use

  1. Add each plant with its watering interval in days and when you last watered it.
  2. The list shows next-due dates, sorted with the thirstiest first and overdue in red.
  3. Tap 'Watered' when you water — the due date recalculates instantly.
  4. Everything is saved in your browser automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where is my plant list stored?

In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool. It stays on this device and browser.

How is the next due date computed?

Last-watered date + interval days. Tapping 'Watered' sets last-watered to today and moves the due date forward.

What counts as overdue?

Any plant whose due date is before today is highlighted red; due today is amber; the rest are green.
